protocol: Sequential GPU experiments; no external CUDA compute workload observed. Desktop graphics clients and unrelated host work left running.
limits: Baseline is the accepted register-tile/split-K candidate from bf16-gemm-idle-acceptance.json; this follow-up measures additional transposed staging gains.
The isolated sweep uses synthetic values, actual dimensions and split-K interleaving, f32 partial/output storage and no model epilogues. It is not a complete-update measurement.
Full PPO compares identical archive, initial weights, batch and settings; three warmups and 64 AB/BA pairs. All native replay requests stayed active with zero fallbacks.

The five-mode matrix uses the same current executable for native f32 and BF16, three warmups and 32 reverse-order retained iterations. Compare within this run; PyTorch request samples vary substantially across runs.

The first complete-update diagnostic did not activate large model copies because its proof did not reconstruct physical batch coordinates. Its preserved worker, samples and trace are separate from the accepted implementation.
Trace spans exclude optimizer, feed uploads, request handling and metrics. Actual trace resource metadata is separate from isolated ptxas reports.
Three native numerical-control steps do not establish original-PyTorch learning parity or multi-seed training quality. Prior BF16 policy boundaries and learning gates are unchanged.
Hardware counters remain unavailable under the existing permissions; no driver settings changed.

mixed_paired.protocol: alternating AB/BA full train requests; same settings/batch/initial weights

f32_paired.protocol: alternating AB/BA full train requests; same settings/batch/initial weights

five_modes.native_memory_accounting: whole worker process MiB, including modules/workspace/graph; sampled outside timing
five_modes.external_workloads: left running; monitor GPU samples for contention
five_modes.timing_protocol: complete synchronized updates; reverse mode order each iteration; warmups excluded

import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('integrations/forty_five').resolve()))
from bridge import Worker
root=Path('target/bf16-staging/native-differential');root.mkdir()
archive=Path('target/forty_five_validation/final-driver/initial')
batch=json.loads(Path('target/forty_five_mixed_ppo/staging-all-modes/batch.json').read_text())
settings=dict(microbatch=64,scheduler_updates=1000,learning_rate=5e-5,value_learning_rate=2e-4,entropy_coef=.005,tree_reductions=True,cuda_graphs=True,tf32x3=True,mixed_bf16=True)
report=dict(settings=settings,steps=3,runs={})
def error(a,b):
 a=np.asarray(a,np.float64).ravel();b=np.asarray(b,np.float64).ravel()
 assert a.shape==b.shape and np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(b).all()
 d=a-b
 return dict(reference_squared=float(b@b),error_squared=float(d@d),max_abs=float(np.abs(d).max()),normalized_l2=float(np.linalg.norm(d)/max(1e-30,np.linalg.norm(b))))
for label,binary in [('baseline-1','baseline-worker'),('baseline-2','baseline-worker'),('candidate','candidate-worker')]:
 executable=Path('target/release/examples/forty_five_worker') if binary=='candidate-worker' else Path('target/bf16-staging/baseline-worker')
 run=dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),steps=[]);report['runs'][label]=run
 with Worker(executable,archive,'cuda') as worker:
  for step in range(1,4):
   actual=worker.request('train',batch=batch,settings=settings,return_gradients=True)
   grads={k:np.asarray(v,np.float32) for k,v in actual.pop('gradients').items()}
   np.savez(root/f'{label}-{step}-gradients.npz',**grads)
   saved=(root/f'{label}-{step}').resolve();worker.request('save',directory=str(saved))
   entry=dict(step=step,metrics=actual['metrics'],gradient_norm=actual['gradient_norm_before_clip'])
   if label!='baseline-1':
    with np.load(root/f'baseline-1-{step}-gradients.npz') as reference:
     assert set(reference.files)==set(grads)
     named={k:error(grads[k],reference[k]) for k in reference.files}
    entry['named_gradients']=named
    entry['global_gradient_l2']=(sum(v['error_squared'] for v in named.values())/max(1e-30,sum(v['reference_squared'] for v in named.values())))**.5
    entry['weights']=error(np.fromfile(saved/'weights.f32',dtype='<f4'),np.fromfile(root/f'baseline-1-{step}'/'weights.f32',dtype='<f4'))
   run['steps'].append(entry)
   (root/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
   print(label,step,entry.get('global_gradient_l2'),entry.get('weights',{}).get('max_abs'),flush=True)
